A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the higher order crack tip field is a general solution for the crack problem of FGM composites.

1) the higher order crack tip field is obtained for the arbitrary FGM composites with arbitrary material functions, 2) the arbitrary FGM composite functions are treated by using the Taylor series expansion at crack tip, and 3) the higher order eigen-functions are obtained by means of the superposition method.

, the higher order crack tip field solutions are obtained by the method of eigen-function expansion for the general power law material function, and this is of great universal value for the research of crack tip fields of arbitrary FGM composite material functions.

the material property function at the crack-tip greatly affects the structure crack tip field, and the higher order terms of crack tip field should be considered in fracture analysis of FGM composites.
the crack tip fields are not only dependent on the material properties at the crack tip, but also dependent on the material property gradient at the crack tip.
